# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>; Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He continuously twirls his mustache.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He tends to spend his attention on older students preparing for examinations while ignoring younger children, and he displays an overbearing, sarcastic tone that students dislike. Though he attempts sudden enforces of discipline, overall his classroom control is considered poor and ineffective.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P60](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0060), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Abilities

- Instructing advanced subjects including Latin, algebra, and geometry  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037)</sub>
- Dramatic recitation and speech delivery  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school, spending much of his classroom time attending to Sukey Pullen under the guise of helping her prepare for entrance exams. He frequently disciplined students arbitrarily, once forcing Nell Harcourt to stand at the blackboard and later ordering her to sit next to Hugh Carrow for being late. When Nell stopped attending school in protest, local opinion criticized his lack of discipline and overbearing attitude, though he eventually accepted Nell back into class without further major conflict. During school events, he recited Mark Antony's address above Cæsar's body and courted Sukey by giving her Mayflowers and writing verses. At the end of June, his term as teacher concluded, and he gave an emotional parting address that moved the entire student body to tears before leaving Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Lodged at the home of Eben Duckett while teaching at Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- Secured his position as schoolmaster largely through his uncle, who was a dominant trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Quotes

> Nell Harcourt, what is the meaning of this?  <sub>[v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>

> It grieves me to observe a student under my instruction showing this kind of rage and this sort of revengeful attitude  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

> Nell, proceed to the dais before the blackboard and remain standing there throughout the remainder of the day.  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>

> Nell Harcourt, because you appear to take such pleasure in the presence of the boys, we will satisfy your desire for it later today  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061)</sub>

> The time has come for us to part.  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>


## Affiliations

- Brierley school — Schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Relationships

### Sukey Pullen

- Romantic with — He courted her constantly during school hours and in the evenings.  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

### Nell Harcourt

- Mentor of — He was her teacher at Brierley school, though they frequently clashed over discipline and spelling.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
